name: task.unprocessed_problem
axis_semantics: JSON structure: train list of {input,output}; test list of {input[, output]}
initialization: copied reference to input problem dict
notes: Raw grids kept as Python lists; not consumed by ARCCompressor.forward

name: task.shapes
axis_semantics: per example: [ [H_in,W_in], [H_out,W_out] ]; test out_shape is PREDICTED not ground truth
initialization: from raw grids; test out_shape filled by branch at 52-62
alias_or_rebinding_risk: YES: all_out_same_size branch (55-58) assigns the SAME list object shapes[0][1] to every test out_shape (shared reference)
notes: No mutation after __init__ found; aliasing is latent risk only

name: task.problem
axis_semantics: axis0 example (train then test); axis1 x; axis2 y; axis3 in/out mode; values are color INDICES into task.colors
initialization: one-hot fill then np.argmax over color axis (115); cells outside grid and the hidden test-output slot argmax to index 0 (black)
notes: Test output slot exists but contains all-zeros -> index 0; it is never read because take_step skips test outputs (62-63)

name: task.masks
axis_semantics: axis0 example; axis1 x; axis2 y; axis3 in/out mode; 1 inside per-example per-mode rectangle else 0; test out rectangle uses PREDICTED shape
read_by: layers.cummax/shift via forward args (arc_compressor 127;131); share_direction masked aggregation (211-230)
role_in_forward: bounds directional ops and masked mean
notes: Only raw-data-derived tensor read inside forward

name: task.colors / n_colors / n_x / n_y / flags
shape_expression: colors: sorted list incl 0; n_colors = len(colors)-1; n_x,n_y = max over all shapes incl predicted
axis_semantics: scalars/list; in_out_same_size, all_in_same_size, all_out_same_size booleans
notes: n_x/n_y include predicted test output shapes (77-78)

name: task.solution
axis_semantics: test example, x, y color indices
initialization: built only when a solution argument is passed
notes: R6A Phase 1 solver passes None (phase1_condition_solver.py:178) so this is None inside the solver process

name: multiposteriors[dims][0] (posterior mean)
shape_expression: multitensor_system.shape(dims, 4) = [n_examples if dims0][n_colors if dims1][8 if dims2][n_x if dims3][n_y if dims4] + [4]
axis_semantics: included axes in fixed order examples,colors,directions,x,y then trailing channel axis of size 4 (decoding_dim)
role_in_forward: source of every activation (via channel_layer sample)
notes: 18 leaves exist (one per valid dims); 15 have the example axis

name: multiposteriors[dims][1] (local_capacity_adjustment)
axis_semantics: same as posterior mean
notes: Registered in weights_list at 29

name: target_capacities[dims]
axis_semantics: single channel axis (decoding_dim); broadcast over all other axes inside channel_layer
notes: One 4-vector per leaf; NOT per-element

name: decode_weights[dims]
shape_expression: [W: (4, ch(dims)), b: (ch(dims),)] where ch(dims)=16 if dims[2]==0 else 8
axis_semantics: linear map channel axis 4 -> residual channel
role_in_forward: maps sampled channel output into residual stream
alias_or_rebinding_risk: YES: symmetrize_xy (initializers 122-126) rebinds y-only leaves to alias the x-only leaf objects; the replaced originals stay in weights_list (orphaned)
notes: Bias used (use_bias=True at layers.py:158)

name: share_up_weights / share_down_weights [layer][dims]
axis_semantics: down-projection then up-projection around cross-leaf communication
updated_by: Adam step (biases unused in forward: use_bias=False at layers 183;237)
notes: 4 layers x 18 leaves each

name: softmax_weights[layer][dims]
axis_semantics: down to 2 channels; softmax over axis subsets multiplies channels by (2^k-1); up back to ch
notes: output_scaling_fn at arc_compressor.py:64

name: cummax_weights / shift_weights [layer][dims]
axis_semantics: split into 2 channel halves x 8 directions inside directional layer
notes: Blocks execute only for dims (1;1;1;1;1) and (1;0;1;1;1) (layers 448;482)

name: direction_share_weights[layer][dims][d1][d2]
axis_semantics: pairwise direction-to-direction linear maps
alias_or_rebinding_risk: YES: symmetrize_direction_sharing (initializers 128-168) rebinds many (dims,d1,d2) cells to representative map objects; replaced originals stay in weights_list
notes: Executes only for dims with direction axis (layers 488-490)

name: nonlinear_weights[layer][dims]
axis_semantics: SiLU applied between projections

name: head_weights
axis_semantics: W maps residual channel(16) of leaf (1,1,0,1,1) to 2 in/out channels; both W columns EQUAL at init (86)
role_in_forward: color-logit head; forward also ADDS 100*head_weights[1] to output (150)
alias_or_rebinding_risk: weights_list[-2] replaced at 90 to keep registration consistent
notes: Columns are independent parameters after init (stack copies values)

name: mask_weights
axis_semantics: maps x-leaf or y-leaf channel(16) to 2 in/out mask channels
role_in_forward: SAME object used for x_mask and y_mask heads (weight sharing)
alias_or_rebinding_risk: shared across two call sites by construction
notes: use_bias=True for mask heads

name: model.weights_list
axis_semantics: ordered by construction sequence
alias_or_rebinding_risk: YES: contains ORPHANED tensors whose multitensor slots were rebound by symmetrize_xy / symmetrize_direction_sharing; orphans receive no gradient
notes: Optimizer param registration set (train.py 137; phase1_condition_solver 182)

name: Adam optimizer state
axis_semantics: per parameter: library internals
notes: Exact state layout is torch library semantics, not repository source; R6A hashes it at phase1_condition_solver.py:60-72

name: Logger.current_logits / current_x_mask / current_y_mask
axis_semantics: test-example slice of black-augmented logits, output mode (index 1)
notes: Slices logits[n_train:] mode 1

name: Logger.ema_logits / ema_x_mask / ema_y_mask
axis_semantics: same

name: Logger.solution_hashes_count / solution_most_frequent / solution_second_most_frequent
axis_semantics: score accumulator per solution hash; two best solutions
notes: Scores: -10*uncertainty; -10 if step<150; -4 for EMA candidate (73-77)

name: forward residual stream x
shape_expression: MultiTensor of per-leaf tensors shape(dims; ch(dims))
axis_semantics: per-leaf axes as posterior mean with channel=ch(dims)
initialization: created fresh each forward from decode_latents

name: KL_amounts / KL_names
shape_expression: list of 18 per-leaf tensors; names are str(dims)
axis_semantics: per-leaf element-wise KL
notes: Order = multitensor iteration order (little-endian bit order; multitensor_systems 70-83)
